name: wetland
job: Map open water and water hidden under reeds and papyrus (flooded vegetation) on every NISAR Pass across the delta, through cloud, day or night
user: Wetland managers and water authorities tracking the yearly flood pulse

labels.source: Sentinel-2 MNDWI open water within 4 days of Passes 2026-06-26, 2026-09-06, 2026-11-05 (open-water training AND scoring); flooded vegetation from physics-agreement pseudo-labels
labels.notes: Optical labels cannot see water under vegetation; the flooded-vegetation class is supported by double-bounce physics, seasonal HH rise, coherence and model agreement, not by independent labels

baseline.name: Otsu threshold on HH, per Pass
baseline.metric: open-water IoU, held-out 5 km blocks, true prevalence (Sentinel-2 MNDWI)

model.name: LightGBM open water + physics-guided flooded vegetation + HMM
model.metric: open-water IoU, held-out 5 km blocks, true prevalence (Sentinel-2 MNDWI)

extra_scores.name: NISAR-ATBD rules
extra_scores.metric: open-water IoU, held-out 5 km blocks, true prevalence (Sentinel-2 MNDWI)

extra_scores.name: GMM + HMM
extra_scores.metric: open-water IoU, held-out 5 km blocks, true prevalence (Sentinel-2 MNDWI)

extra_scores.name: Baseline: Otsu on HH, predicted open-water share
LightGBM (S2 labels, tuned threshold), predicted open-water share
Flooded-vegetation LightGBM, agreement with held-out physics seeds

split: Open water: spatial 5-fold CV over 5 km blocks; Model and Baseline scored on the same held-out random pixels at true prevalence; the LightGBM decision threshold for each fold is chosen on the other folds only. Model selected on this same score.
limits: Flooded vegetation is not validated against independent labels (none exist under canopy); treat it as physics-supported
Wind-roughened open water is bright and can be missed; very dense wet canopy can suppress double bounce
Dual-pol (HH/HV) only: no VV, no full polarimetric decomposition
Fixed thresholds seed the models and come from Amazon/UAVSAR studies; papyrus and reed may differ (the GMM and HMM adapt them)
PROVISIONAL GCOV calibration may shift; re-run when VALIDATED products exist
